data.name: HelpSubtitle
data.value: Everything you need to order, pay, and track your orders.

data.name: HelpTagline
data.value: From the Market to Your Door

data.name: HelpIntroBody
data.value: DoorMarket lets you browse products from multiple shops, add items to your cart, choose delivery to your address, and pay online. After payment, the shop processes the order and you track its status until delivery.

data.name: HelpHowStep4
data.value: Enter your delivery address to estimate fees.

data.name: HelpHowStep6
data.value: Track status: Paid → Processed → Delivered (or Cancelled).

data.name: HelpHowTip
data.value: Tip: You can browse and build your cart without an account. An account is required only at checkout.

data.name: HelpProductsBody
data.value: Products come from partner shops. Prices and stock may change. If an item becomes unavailable, the shop may adjust the order based on business rules.

data.name: HelpCartBody1
data.value: You can add items to your cart even without an account.

data.name: HelpCartBody2
data.value: An account is required at checkout to secure the order and enable tracking.

data.name: HelpCartReason2
data.value: Store delivery details needed for fulfillment.

data.name: HelpDeliveryBody1
data.value: Delivery fees are calculated based on your address and the shop address.

data.name: HelpDeliveryBody2
data.value: If your cart contains multiple shops, fees may consider the farthest shop.

data.name: HelpDeliveryBody3
data.value: A small extra fee may apply above a certain number of shops.

data.name: HelpDeliveryNote
data.value: Checkout total includes: items subtotal + delivery fee.

data.name: HelpStripeBody
data.value: Payments are secure and handled by Stripe. Accepted cards depend on the provider and your bank (Visa, MasterCard, etc.).

data.name: HelpPayPalBody
data.value: You are redirected to PayPal to confirm. DoorMarket only receives payment confirmation.

data.name: HelpPrepaidBody
data.value: Pay using a prepaid balance or code depending on available options. If it fails, the order may remain pending or be cancelled.

data.name: HelpPaymentsNote
data.value: Important: DoorMarket must not store sensitive card data (CVC). Stripe/PayPal collect card details on secure pages.

data.name: HelpAccountBody
data.value: Your account helps secure orders and keep your information accessible.

data.name: HelpStatusItem1
data.value: Pending: order created, waiting for processing.

data.name: HelpStatusItem2
data.value: Paid: payment confirmed, the shop is notified.

data.name: HelpStatusItem3
data.value: Processed / Preparing: the shop is preparing.

data.name: HelpStatusItem4
data.value: Out for delivery: the order is on the way.

data.name: HelpStatusItem5
data.value: Delivered: order delivered to the customer.

data.name: HelpStatusItem6
data.value: Cancelled / Failed: cancelled or payment/stock issue.

data.name: HelpShopBody1
data.value: When an order is paid, the shop receives an email notification “Paid order pending”.

data.name: HelpShopBody2
data.value: From the Shop Dashboard, you can view the order and update status (Pending → Processed → Delivered, or Cancelled if needed).

data.name: HelpFaqQ1
data.value: Can I browse products without an account?

data.name: HelpFaqA1
data.value: Yes. You can browse and build your cart. An account is required only at checkout.

data.name: HelpFaqQ2
data.value: Why is an account required at payment time?

data.name: HelpFaqA2
data.value: To secure the order, enable tracking, and support delivery.

data.name: HelpFaqQ3
data.value: How do I know the payment succeeded?

data.name: HelpFaqA3
data.value: After payment you return to DoorMarket and the order is marked “Paid”.

data.name: HelpFaqA4
data.value: Based on distance between your address and the shop (or the farthest shop if multiple), with possible multi-shop fee.

data.name: HelpFaqQ5
data.value: Do you store my card details?

data.name: HelpFaqA5
data.value: No. Stripe/PayPal handle payments; DoorMarket does not store the CVC.

data.name: HelpFaqQ6
data.value: What if an item is out of stock?

data.name: HelpFaqA6
data.value: The shop may adjust or cancel the order based on business rules; you will be informed depending on configuration.

data.name: HelpFaqA7
data.value: Use the French / English language selector in the menu.
